data.case_title: Fine notice for using a mobile phone while driving (Bußgeldbescheid)
data.summary: The Kreis Beispielsauerland – Bußgeldstelle imposed a fine of €128.50 on Laura Beispielwinkel for holding and using a mobile phone while driving on 18 March 2027 in Musterberg. The notice adds 1 point to the driving register (Fahreignungsregister) and can be challenged with an objection (Einspruch) within two weeks of delivery; the attached delivery record shows it was delivered on 3 May 2027.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for using a handheld phone while driving. It totals €128.50 (fine, administrative fee and delivery costs) and adds one point to the driving register. You may accept it or file a written objection (Einspruch) with the Bußgeldstelle; the app shows the deadline for that. Do not pay before the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) — once it is final, transfer the amount within two weeks, quoting the case number. If no objection is filed by the deadline shown, the notice becomes final and enforceable automatically. Consider consulting a traffic lawyer (Fachanwalt für Verkehrsrecht) if you want to contest it.

– Bußgeldstelle schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift einzulegen.
